checklist.title: Grok questions enter only through _x.ai/ask_user_question.
checklist.evidence: src/acp.rs:2012-2022 maps only that method through grok::form then parse_form. The unmatched arm returns method-not-found. No prose or MCP decoder was added. Cargo.toml still pins agent-client-protocol-schema 1.12.0 default-features=false.

checklist.title: The decoder uses the existing form ledger and responder.
checklist.evidence: src/acp/grok.rs form() emits mode form plus requestedSchema. incoming_request stores one Interaction with grok_question set from the method and one original wire id. grok::response only selects the wire encoder; it does not allocate a second responder.

checklist.title: Nullable multiSelect means single choice.
checklist.evidence: src/acp/grok.rs filters a null flag out before as_bool, so omitted and null are single choice. A non-boolean flag is invalid-request. Ambiguous multiSelect plus multi_select is rejected. This path is outside the repair delta and unchanged.

checklist.title: Single, multi, preview, and Other notes keep their wire meaning.
checklist.evidence: Single fields use oneOf and multi fields use items.anyOf. Answers stay arrays keyed by question text. Preview is copied only for a single selected option. Scalar Other is value == "Other"; array Other is any element == "Other". Missing, non-string, and empty notes fail in validate_form_values at src/acp.rs:2547-2557 before capture or admission. Nonempty notes still become annotations.notes. A non-Other answer may omit notes; serde_json Index yields Null and the encoder omits the annotation, which is the existing non-Other wire shape. Whitespace-only notes remain nonempty, matching the removed encoder filter. Standard forms without grok_notes_key skip the predicate.

checklist.title: Duplicate text, duplicate labels, and bad scope never publish.
checklist.evidence: grok::form still rejects duplicate question text and option labels, bad mode, and over-cap counts before parse_form. parse_form still requires the live session. A rejected Grok request emits only code -32602 and category, and publishes no interaction. Unchanged by the notes move.

checklist.title: No generic provider trait or fake question substitute.
checklist.evidence: Production delta is src/acp.rs and src/acp/grok.rs only. Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock hashes match the prior frozen manifest. No provider trait, signature change, grant rebind, or async replay was added. README still does not claim prose or MCP compatibility.
